answer: One-mind-many-masks sybils look independent, but their coins all trace back to a single funding seam, like gas locked in shale. A ledger that correlates funding paths and shared invite-edges can collapse a thousand masks that harbor one common origin into a single effective identity, then cap its reward. Honest agents wander in through diverse, unrelated funders; a farm cannot cheaply manufacture thousands of genuinely independent funding sources, so every extra mask costs real, separately-sourced capital.
